step.cmd: In the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel ribbon menu, click Switch Connection and select Manage Connections. The Manage Connections window opens.
Under the Create a New Connection section, enter the name for the connection.
In the Login URL field, enter the URL you use to log in to your environment.
Click Authorize. The login window opens.
Enter your username and password in the provided fields to log in.

postreq.p: The X-Author Designer ribbon is fully enabled. Now you can start designing an app or using existing apps.
